venue_notes: STATUS: no vendor has been contacted or has confirmed anything, because I have no communication tools in this session. Every item below is open. R1 open: confirm the venue booking for 12 Sep 2026 and a 96-guest capacity.

R2 open: written confirmation is needed from venue, caterer, DJ, photographer and shuttle company for ceremony 16:00, cocktails 17:15, dinner 19:30 and last shuttle 01:30. Get overtime costs for the late finish in the all-in quotes.

R5 open: get written nut-free confirmation, including cross-contamination handling, from the caterer and the cake supplier. No almonds in the cake. A nephew carries an EpiPen. The menu is not yet defined, so the menu list is empty. 11 vegetarian and 4 children's meals are to be confirmed with the caterer.

R7 open: send the DJ a written do-not-play list with Macarena and get acknowledgement.

R8 CLIENT DECISION: the count of Eero's family RSVPs is unknown. Finnish is added to the menu cards only if more than 25 confirm. Ask the client for the count and have the printer prepare both versions.

R10 open: the 42,000 EUR hard cap applies. Collect all-in quotes (taxes, service, overtime), report the running total, and commit to nothing that would exceed the cap.
R11: cut order is fireworks first, then photo booth, late bar and flowers. The interpreter and microphone are protected and last.
R12 open: tell the caterer, DJ and shuttle company that dinner at 19:30 holds. If the ceremony starts late, shorten the cocktails, never the ceremony.
R13: seating is planned as Aino-Kaarina next to Päivikki in the front row. Tell the venue and the photographer.
R14 open: inform the quinta that a dog is attending and obtain their pet policy and any conditions (leash, handler, areas allowed, fees, catering-area restrictions).
CLIENT DECISIONS NEEDED: confirm the date, the Eero family RSVP count, approval of the replacement photographer, and the menu and cake choices.
